title: TikTok - statistics & facts
description: TikTok has established itself as one of the most influential social media platforms in the world. The app shapes how millions create, consume, and share content. Its success as a short-form video leader is matched by its evolving regulatory landscape, including a landmark U.S. divestiture deal finalized in January 2026. Despite these shifts, TikTok's story demonstrates the staying power of short-form video and the constant need for social media to evolve alongside its audiences.
